newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar heads lower, tracks NY bears.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar heads lower, tracks NY bears.

text.p: London's October white sugar contract drifted lower to bounce off initial support at $326.00 but activity was lacklustre as nearby positions held steady in tight ranges, traders said on Monday.
A bearish New York market compounded the weakness seen earlier in the day although the London market was still considered to have more downside potential.
"There'll be a few stops another $2 below these levels but with time you may see it drift off this week," said one trader.
"But there's no strong feeling about it," he said.
At 1500 GMT October was down $1.30 at $326.00 and December down by the same amount at $321.50. Volume stayed on the light side and totalled a meagre 584 lots.
Paris was also weaker but volume was thin at just 73 lots. October and December were both down $1.60, at $325.60 and $320.60 respectively.
